title: I'm a Celebrity: AJ Odudu is the first star ever sent home before reaching camp
summary: The presenter lost a launch-night challenge to Claire Sweeney in a new twist.
body:
AJ Odudu has become the first celebrity in the history of I'm a Celebrity... Get Me Out of Here! to be sent home before reaching the camp.

On Monday night's launch episode, Ant and Dec revealed that the loser of a head-to-head challenge would leave the show straight away. Odudu lost to the actress Claire Sweeney.

A divided reaction

Wayne Rooney, one of her fellow contestants, called it "brutal to send someone home on the first day". Viewers were split over the new twist.

The series continues nightly on ITV1 and ITVX.

Sources: TV Guide, HuffPost UK.
